description: This Kotlin source file defines the `TicTacToeViewModel` class, which manages the UI state for a Tic-Tac-Toe game within an Android application. The ViewModel handles persisting and restoring game state using `SavedStateHandle`, exposes methods for game actions such as cell taps and restarting the game, and interacts with the game logic implemented in `GameEngine`. It's responsible for maintaining the current game state and exposing it to the UI in a reactive manner.

classes.name: TicTacToeViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel class managing UI state for Tic-Tac-Toe game.

methods.name: onCellTapped
methods.description: Handles the event when a cell in the Tic-Tac-Toe board is tapped, updating the game state accordingly.

methods.name: onRestart
methods.description: Resets the game to the initial state and clears any persistent UI state.

methods.name: markOutcomeShown
methods.description: Marks that the game outcome has been shown to the user, updating the saved state.

methods.name: persistState
methods.description: Saves current game state variables into SavedStateHandle for persistence across configuration changes.

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores game state from SavedStateHandle or initializes a new game state if none is saved.
